events.title: Drupal 11 released
events.summary: Drupal 11.0 shipped on August 2, 2024 — upgrading to Symfony 7, modern PHP 8.3 requirements, and a refined admin experience.
events.about: Drupal 11 removed legacy compatibility shims from Drupal 10 — requiring PHP 8.3 and updated dependencies. It launched alongside Drupal 10.3 as the supported path forward before Drupal 10 end-of-life in 2026.

narrative.whyChosen: Drupal 11 keeps the platform on supported Symfony and PHP releases.
narrative.whyImportant: It maintains Drupal's enterprise CMS position through the mid-2020s stack.
narrative.problemSolved: Drupal 10 sites needed a migration path before Symfony 6 and PHP 8.1 reached end-of-life.

events.title: Google Pixel 9 released
events.summary: Google began selling the Google Pixel 9 — Tensor G4 and Gemini Nano on-device AI features.
events.about: Nexus and Pixel phones were Google's pure-Android reference hardware for developers. Tensor g4 and gemini nano on-device ai features. AOSP builds and CTS testing often used Pixel devices as the baseline.

narrative.whyChosen: The Google Pixel 9 was a flagship Google Android reference device.
narrative.whyImportant: Pixel/Nexus hardware defines the reference Android experience for developers.
narrative.problemSolved: Android needed first-party reference phones without OEM skin fragmentation.
